warnings: This is a biostimulant study, not CO2 - the CO2 context is irrelevant
Multiple cultivars tested (6 hybrids) - need to extract each cultivar separately
Two-year study (2013, 2014) - may need separate extractions per year
Factorial design: cultivar × biostimulant × year interactions reported
Units are kg/m² which need conversion to standard yield units
Early yield vs total yield reported - focus on total marketable yield
Control is clearly defined as distilled water spray vs biostimulant treatment
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: Data are means for three replications ±SD. Different letters between cultivars and treatments denote significant differences
recon.control_definition: Control plants were sprayed with distilled water
recon.treatment_definition: Biostimulant Göemar BM-86 (Ascophyllum nodosum extract) applied as foliar spraying (3-times, in a dose 1.5dm³ha⁻¹)
recon.sample_size_source: completely randomized block design experiment, three replications per a treatment
recon.factorial_structure: ["cultivar (6 levels)", "biostimulant (2 levels: control vs treatment)", "year (2 levels: 2013, 2014)"]
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract yield data from Figure 2 only (early and marketable yield in kg/m²). Each cultivar × treatment × year combination should be extracted separately. Control = C (distilled water), Treatment = B (biostimulant). Convert kg/m² to kg/ha by multiplying by 10,000. Use SD values shown as error bars. Focus on marketable yield as primary outcome, but early yield can also be extracted as secondary outcome.
